effective_date_basis: For a boundary change: whether it remains part of the current boundary description, or the date of the later instrument that changed the same lands.
ending_pattern: Boundary changes are usually effective on signing and then merged into the forest's current boundary; later proclamations and orders may move the boundary again. An administrative-site reservation continues until revoked.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Lands restored to entry are subject to valid existing rights.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order also creates a reservation for another agency.
The order is a proclamation in form (check the form).

Eliminations or additions in Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Montana, Colorado and Wyoming after March 4, 1907 (34 Stat. 1271 bars creating or enlarging national forests there except by Act of Congress): an authority question to flag.
The forest was renamed or consolidated: the boundary continues under another name.
Eliminated lands were later re-added by a later proclamation.
